title: Burung Pesan Teh Tarik
subject: a murai bird hung at a kopitiam hook each morning copies the kettle whistle and the aunty's 'teh tarik satu', and now customers order from the bird
caption: DC go-go live groove, nonstop conga and cowbell pocket with a swung sixteenth-note shuffle. Congas and timbales up front, cowbell on every beat, funk guitar chops with wah, round electric bass, short brass stabs. Live club room, dry and punchy, crowd-style group answers. Male lead with group shouts answering each line, bright mid register. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, G minor. Playful, bouncy, comic mood. No trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - congas and cowbell lock in, guitar chop]

[Verse 1]
Pagi-pagi Abang Din gantung sangkar
Kat kopitiam Ipoh, tepi tiang kipas
Burung murai tengok cerek mendidih
Dia dengar bunyi, dia pun tiru

[Pre-Chorus]
Piii, cerek berbunyi
Teh tarik satu, teh tarik satu

[Chorus]
Teh tarik satu, kata burung
Teh tarik satu, jawab budak
Kopi O kosong, kata burung
Kopi O kosong, jawab dapur

[Verse 2]
Pelanggan baru duduk, tak sempat buka mulut
Burung dah jerit, Roti bakar dua!
Mak Cik kaunter ketawa, pegang perut
Abang Din garu kepala, duit masuk laci

[Bridge - congas alone, handclaps]
Siapa nak kopi, tanya burung
Siapa bayar, tanya burung

[Chorus]
Teh tarik satu, kata burung
Teh tarik satu, semua jawab
Kopi O kosong, kata burung
Kopi O kosong, satu kedai nyanyi

[Outro - cowbell and congas fade, last brass stab]
Teh tarik satu
